paragraphs: Raptor Technologies sells school safety software and training that districts, schools and childcare centers use to build a safer learning environment. The company dates to 2002.

Its products are grouped into four suites covering emergency management, campus movement, student wellbeing, and safety training and compliance. That range runs from everyday work such as dismissals and visitor management through emergency response, reunification and Alyssa's Law compliance. Campus tools are meant to show staff who is on site and why, in real time. Other pieces are built to help schools prepare for, respond to and recover from emergencies.

The company describes itself as the school safety partner for more than 60,000 schools in 55 countries. Those counts are given as of 2025 and cover active customer accounts. It sells software and mobile technology alongside training and consultation across the school safety lifecycle. Customers get custom implementations and training as part of the relationship.
